simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כֵּילַף (H3597) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: כֵּילַף (kêylaph) means a club or sledge-hammer First listed occurrence: Ps 74 6.

definitions.full: H3597. kelappoth כֵּילַמּוֺת noun [feminine] axe (loan-word (compare Frä 74 ) from Assyrian kalappatu see Dl HWB 333 ) — וְכ ׳בְּכַשִּׁיל יַהֲלֹמ֑וּן Psa 74:6 (|| קַרְדֻּמּוֺת 74:5 ). כִּימָה see below כום .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise;
